issues.on_page: Other local receipts 527,499 (General 23,772; Other Governmental 503,727 = Activities receipts 467,652 p19 + nutrition Other receipts 36,075 p15)
issues.issue: [fixed 2026-10-28: category changed to Extracurricular Receipts (dominant part, 89% Activities Fund receipts), review note kept] 467,652 of the 527,499 (89%) is Activities Fund receipts; the rules put school activity fund receipts in Extracurricular Receipts and use the dominant part's category for broad 'Other local receipts' lines. Charges for services/fees is only for genuine service fees. The category should be Extracurricular Receipts, keeping the review note.
[fixed 2026-10-28: category changed to Rentals] Rental receipts have their own receipt category, Rentals (user 2026-10-28), not charges for services/fees.
The label mixes licence fees and fines, so the Fines and Licenses category may fit better. The line is already marked review.
The printed label is 'Other receipts' and the page doesn't say what it is. Charges for services/fees is an assumption (it could be School Lunch Sales or other). Already marked review.
